ui.invokeDescription: Skript chce za vás spustit „{{label}}“, jako byste na to klikli.

visualization.critiqueSystem: You are judging how well a scientific image visualization reads, not what the specimen is. Comment only on the rendering: contrast, dynamic range, colour choice, whether an overlay is distinguishable from the image beneath it, and whether structure is lost to saturation or washed out. Do not diagnose, do not name tissue types, and do not speculate about the specimen. Answer in at most four short sentences.
visualization.critiquePrompt: Describe what is wrong with how this view is rendered and what would make the data easier to read.
visualization.critiqueQuestion: Describe what is wrong with how this view is rendered, focusing on: {{question}}
visualization.critiqueIncomplete: IMPORTANT: this image is INCOMPLETE — some image tiles had not finished loading when it was captured, so parts of it are blank or missing. Blank or abruptly cut-off areas are loading artefacts, not rendering faults and not properties of the specimen. Judge only the areas that did render, and say explicitly that the view was incomplete.

basic.title: Základní funkce
basic.description: Posun, přiblížení, navigace a úprava aktivní vizualizace.
basic.viewer:
Toto je prohlížeč sklíček. Tažením posouváte, kolečkem myši přibližujete; fungují také šipky a + / -.
V relacích s více prohlížeči existuje každý níže uvedený panel pro každý prohlížeč zvlášť; prohlídka prochází ten aktivní.
basic.navigator: Otevřete kartu Navigátor na pravém okraji a zobrazí se minimapa. Kliknutím kamkoli na minimapu přeskočíte přímo na danou oblast.
basic.openLayers: Kliknutím sem otevřete kartu Vrstvy — tam upravíte aktivní vizualizaci.
basic.visualizationPicker: Pokud relace obsahuje více vizualizací, přepínejte mezi nimi v tomto rozbalovacím seznamu. Seznam shaderů níže se okamžitě aktualizuje.
basic.layers: Každý řádek je jeden shader/překryv. Přepínejte viditelnost, tažením měňte pořadí, kliknutím na ozubené kolo otevřete prolínání a ovládání shaderu pro danou vrstvu.
basic.cache: Zde si uložte snímek úprav shaderů. Při povolených cookies je vrstva se stejným názvem při příštím otevření relace převezme.
basic.hideUi: Skrýt celé rozhraní pro nerušený pohled na sklíčko. Dalším kliknutím vše vrátíte zpět.
basic.viewMenu: Nabídka Zobrazení přepíná panely (navigátor, vrstvy, panel nástrojů), inspektor vizualizace a motiv.
basic.reopen: Seznam tutoriálů můžete odsud kdykoli znovu otevřít.

view.title: Inspektor, nabídka Úpravy a Playground
view.description: Nahlédněte pod překryv, upravte nastavení a bezpečně experimentujte.
view.inspector: Pokud relace povoluje inspektor vizualizace, při najetí myší na sklíčko uvidíte, co je pod ním: v režimu odhalit vně překryv pod kurzorem mizí; režim odhalit uvnitř zobrazuje překryv pouze tam.
view.editMenu: Inspektor zapnete a jeho režimy přepnete v nabídce Úpravy (hledejte Inspektor vizualizace).
view.playground: Klikněte pravým tlačítkem kamkoli na sklíčko → Prohlížeč → Otevřít Visualization Playground. Aktuální vizualizace se naklonuje do izolovaného prostředí, kde můžete měnit typ shaderu, paletu, zlomy a parametry — konfigurace relace zůstane nedotčena.
view.fullscreen: Zkombinujte inspektor s funkcí Skrýt celé rozhraní pro nerušené porovnávání.

core.toggleJoystickDesc: Přepne režim navigace joystickem. Je-li zapnut, stiskněte a podržte primární tlačítko myši pro umístění kotvy a pohybem myši plynule posouvejte — čím dále od kotvy, tím rychleji.

virtualization.sidebysideWarning: Rozdělení vedle sebe otevře každou oblast jako samostatné sklíčko/prohlížeč s vlastní identitou — anotace a uložená data jsou vázána na oblast, nikoli na původní sklíčko. Pro zachování jediné identity sklíčka použijte režim 'overlaid' (překryv).
virtualization.sourceNotCompositable: Toto sklíčko nelze rozdělit na virtuální oblasti: jeho dlaždice nejsou běžné obrázky, takže dlaždice na hranici oblasti nelze znovu složit. Rozdělení je v současnosti omezeno na standardní obrazové pyramidy.

pathology.clickPointPrompt: Klikněte na bod na sklíčku, který chcete segmentovat, nebo stiskněte Esc pro zrušení.
pathology.selectAnnotationPrompt: Vyberte na sklíčku anotaci, kterou chcete změřit, nebo stiskněte Esc pro zrušení.
pathology.consentDescription: Skript chce odeslat snímek aktuálního sklíčka patologickému modelu.
pathology.consentContextUnknown: Kontext sklíčka: neurčen — model bude informován, že barvení a místo odběru vzorku nejsou známy, a bude mu zakázáno je uvádět.
pathology.overviewHintPrompt: This is a low-magnification overview of a whole pathology slide. Briefly describe the tissue present and note any regions that look worth examining more closely. Keep it to a few sentences and do not give a diagnosis.
pathology.reviewRegionPrompt: Describe the tissue visible in this region of the pathology slide. Keep it concise and do not give a definitive diagnosis.
pathology.overviewRegionPrompt: In 1-2 sentences describe the tissue you see and whether it looks worth examining at higher magnification. Do not give a diagnosis.
pathology.overviewQueryPrompt: The reviewer is looking for: {{query}}. In 1-2 sentences describe what you see and how well it matches that. Do not give a diagnosis.
pathology.ctxIntro: This is one region of a pathology slide.
pathology.ctxStainHistochemical: This slide is stained with {{stain}}, which shows tissue morphology and tinctorial contrast only. Report only what that kind of stain can reveal. It carries no result for any named molecular target, so do not report one, and do not report the result of any staining method that was not applied here.
pathology.ctxStainTargeted: This slide is stained with {{stain}}, which reports only these targets: {{targets}}. You may comment on the staining of those targets and on morphology. Any other target was not assayed here — do not report a result for it.
pathology.ctxStainFluorescence: This is a fluorescence image ({{stain}}) with these labelled channels: {{targets}}. Signal in a channel indicates only its own label. Do not attribute signal to an unlabelled target, and do not read tinctorial morphology from pseudo-coloured channels.
pathology.ctxStainUnstained: This image is unstained/label-free ({{stain}}). It carries no staining result at all — describe structure only.
pathology.ctxStainNamedUnknownClass: This slide is stained with {{stain}}. Report only what that stain can reveal. Do not report the result of any named target or staining method that was not applied here — only the stain named above was.
pathology.ctxStainUnknown: The staining method is NOT known. Do not name one, and do not report the result of any named target or method — none can be established from this image alone. Describe only the structure you can see.
pathology.ctxOrganUnknown: The specimen site is NOT known. Do not name a site or organ unless the morphology is unambiguous — prefer neutral wording such as 'the tissue'.
pathology.ctxScale: This view spans about {{fovWidthUm}} × {{fovHeightUm}} µm at {{mag}}× objective equivalent ({{mpp}} µm/pixel).
pathology.ctxScaleUncalibrated: This view spans about {{fovWidthPx}} × {{fovHeightPx}} image pixels. The slide is uncalibrated, so no physical size is available — do not estimate structure sizes in µm.
pathology.ctxGeometry: The framed box is an APPROXIMATE bounding box around detected tissue, padded by {{paddingPercent}}%, and only about {{fillPercent}}% of it is tissue — the rest is empty background. It covers {{slideAreaFraction}}% of the slide. Describe only the tissue; do not treat background as tissue, and do not infer a structure spanning the box from separated fragments within it.
pathology.ctxGeometryNoFill: The framed box is an APPROXIMATE bounding box around detected tissue, padded by {{paddingPercent}}%, and may contain a large amount of empty background. It covers {{slideAreaFraction}}% of the slide. Describe only the tissue; do not treat background as tissue, and do not infer a structure spanning the box from separated fragments within it.
pathology.ctxParent: You are at drill level {{level}}. The enclosing region was described as: "{{parentGist}}". Confirm or REFUTE that description for this smaller view — state explicitly if it does not hold here.
pathology.ctxResolutionShortfall: This render is COARSER than intended for this step — about {{renderedMpp}} µm/pixel, because the region is too large to deliver at full detail in one image. Nuclear detail, chromatin and nucleoli are not present in this image at all. Describe what this resolution genuinely supports (architecture, staining pattern, tissue distribution) and do not infer cell-level features from it.
pathology.ctxHonesty: Report only what is visible in THIS image at THIS resolution. Do not describe features that this resolution cannot show, and do not fill them in from what the tissue type usually looks like. Judging the view and judging the tissue are separate: score the region's potential, and report separately whether this view could actually answer the question.
pathology.verdictContract: Finally, on ONE last line with nothing after it, output exactly: SCORE: <decimal between 0 and 1, e.g. 0.35> DRILL: <yes|no> CONFIDENCE: <low|medium|high> RESOLVABLE: <yes|no>. SCORE must be between 0 and 1 — never a 1-5 or 1-10 rating, never a placeholder. RESOLVABLE is about THIS IMAGE, not the tissue: 'no' means the features the question asks about cannot be judged at this resolution and the region must be re-read closer. RESOLVABLE: no is not a low score — an unreadable view says nothing about how interesting the region is.
pathology.verdictRepairPrompt: Your previous answer did not end with the required line. Reply with ONLY: SCORE: <0..1> DRILL: <yes|no> CONFIDENCE: <low|medium|high> RESOLVABLE: <yes|no>
pathology.overviewProgressCancelling: Zastavování — dokončuje se právě zpracovávaná oblast…
pathology.overviewProgressHint: Analýza běží uvnitř prohlížeče — navigace a další nástroje mohou do jejího dokončení reagovat pomaleji.
pathology.warnCancelled: The walk was stopped early — these are the regions described so far, not the whole slide.
pathology.warnUnparsedVerdict: {{count}} region(s) returned no usable SCORE line; their interest is unknown, not zero.
pathology.warnContextUnknown: The stain and/or specimen site were not supplied, so findings were constrained to structure only. Provide them and rebuild for a better overview.
pathology.warnUnresolvedLeaves: {{count}} region(s) were never read at sufficient resolution — their findings describe tissue architecture, not cell-level detail. Inspect them closer before treating them as a close read.
pathology.warnLadderUncalibrated: The slide has no physical calibration, so the walk used fixed magnification steps instead of resolution targets — the detail reached per step is approximate.
pathology.warnContradiction: Conflict: {{childLabel}} (level {{childLevel}}) contradicts its enclosing {{parentLabel}} (level {{parentLevel}}) about '{{feature}}'. The closer view is usually the reliable one, but report that both were seen rather than quoting only one.
pathology.warnTruncated: A budget cap stopped the walk early — this overview is partial. It can be continued where it stopped with refineOverview; rebuilding it would pay again for everything already examined.
pathology.overviewDigest:
Highest-interest regions from the slide overview:
{{lines}}
pathology.overviewDigestQuery:
Regions most relevant to '{{query}}' from the slide overview:
{{lines}}
pathology.overviewDigestEmpty: The overview produced no described regions.
pathology.consentInterrogate: Bude odesláno až {{fields}} snímků vybrané oblasti při vysokém zvětšení.
pathology.consentMontage: {{count}} snímků oblastí bude spojeno do jednoho obrázku a odesláno.
pathology.montageIntro: This image is a COMPOSITE of {{count}} separate, non-adjacent fields taken from different parts of one pathology slide, labelled {{labels}}. They are not one continuous scene.
pathology.montageScale: Each field spans about {{widthUm}} × {{heightUm}} µm at {{mpp}} µm per pixel.
pathology.montageCellLegend: Each field's label is drawn at its top-left corner, and the fields are separated by plain borders. Do not read any structure across a border, and do not infer any relationship from where a field sits in the grid.
pathology.montageDefaultPrompt: For each labelled field, describe the tissue in one short sentence and say how it compares with the others.
pathology.montageContract: Answer field by field. Start each answer on its own line with that field's label exactly as shown, then the answer. Do not give a diagnosis.
pathology.warnSurveyIncomplete: Not every tissue region was surveyed before the budget ran out, so parts of the slide were never looked at. Treat the absence of a finding as 'not examined', not as 'not present'.
pathology.warnScopedCoverage: This walk was restricted to one area of the slide, not the whole slide. Report the findings as covering that area only — the rest of the slide was never looked at.
pathology.warnSurveyPartialRender: The slide image was still loading when it was surveyed, so this is a reading of the tiles that had arrived — NOT of the slide. The tissue regions below are incomplete and their coverage is understated; do not report them as what the slide contains. Wait a moment and run the overview again.
pathology.warnSurveyImplausible: The survey found almost no tissue and only a single region on a whole-slide scan, which is what a half-loaded slide looks like rather than a nearly-empty one. Treat the region list as unreliable, and re-run the overview once the slide has finished loading before reporting anything from it.
pathology.summaryNotExamined: NOT AN EXAMINATION: no region was read at a resolution that can answer these questions. The lines below say what was asked, not what the tissue shows — 'not assessable' means never seen, which is not a negative finding.
pathology.warnNoProgress: The walk stopped with {{unspent}} vision call(s) unused while questions were still open — it never found a region it could read closely, so the tissue was NOT examined in detail. Do not present this as a completed examination; the budget was not the limit, so re-running it unchanged will do the same thing. refineOverview with a region or a higher maxDepth is what can still get closer.
pathology.warnPlannedNotRead: {{count}} planned field(s) were never read, so part of the examined area was skipped. Treat the absence of a finding there as 'not examined', not as 'not present'. refineOverview reads them without repeating anything already done.
pathology.checklistSystem: You turn a pathologist's question into a short, machine-readable checklist of the features that would answer it. You do not answer the question yourself and you never examine an image.
pathology.checklistPrompt: The reviewer is examining a pathology slide (stain: {{stain}}; site: {{organ}}) and asks: "{{query}}". List at most 6 features whose presence or absence would answer that question. Reply with ONLY a JSON array, each entry {"id": "<short_snake_case_id>", "label": "<short human label>", "question": "<one question to ask of a single field of view>", "requiredMpp": <micrometres per pixel needed to judge it: about 2 for tissue architecture, 1 for growth pattern, 0.5 for glandular and cellular detail, 0.25 for nuclear detail>, "weight": <0..1, how much this feature matters to the question>}. Order the features from most to least decisive. {{finest}}
pathology.checklistSlideFinest: For reference, the finest resolution this particular scan holds is {{finest}} µm/px; a feature needing finer detail than that cannot be judged on this slide, so prefer a requirement this scan can meet unless the feature genuinely requires more.
pathology.fieldChecklistIntro: Answer each of the following about the tissue in THIS image. Each item has a short id; use the id exactly as given.
pathology.fieldAnswerContract: First write one or two sentences describing what you see. Then, on its own and with nothing after it, output a single JSON object with one entry per id above: {"<id>": {"a": "<one short sentence>", "p": "yes|no|uncertain|not-assessable", "c": "low|medium|high"}}. Use "not-assessable" when THIS image at THIS resolution cannot show the feature — that is not a negative finding and not a low score; answering "no" instead would report the feature as absent when it was simply never visible.
pathology.answerRepairPrompt: Your previous answer did not end with the required JSON object. Reply with ONLY that object: one entry per id, each {"a": "<one short sentence>", "p": "yes|no|uncertain|not-assessable", "c": "low|medium|high"}.
pathology.checklistFallbackMatch: Does the tissue in this image match what the reviewer is looking for: {{query}}?
pathology.checklistFallbackExtent: How much of this field is involved by whatever stands out in it?
pathology.checklistFallbackQuality: Is the image quality and resolution sufficient to judge this field at all?
pathology.evidenceEmpty: The overview established none of the requested features.
pathology.warnChecklistFallback: No feature checklist was derived for this run, so regions were scored against a generic 'does this match the question' prompt rather than named features. Ask a more specific question, or supply features, for a sharper result.
pathology.warnChecklistDerivationFailed: A question was given, but the feature checklist could not be derived from it ({{reason}}), so regions were scored against a generic 'does this match the question' prompt rather than named features. This is a setup problem, not a problem with the question — rephrasing it will not help. Supply `features` explicitly for a sharper result.

checklistFallbackReason.no-model: no assistant text model is reachable from this deployment
checklistFallbackReason.unparseable: the model's reply held no usable checklist

pathology.warnFieldsUnread: {{count}} of {{total}} field(s) could not be rendered, so no image of them ever reached the model ({{reason}}). Any 'not assessable' answer below covers a field that was never looked at. This is a rendering or tile-loading failure, NOT a resolution limit: re-running the same request is the correct next step, and zooming in or asking for a smaller area will not help.
pathology.warnFeatureUnassessed: {{count}} requested feature(s) were never read at sufficient resolution: {{features}}. They are reported as not assessable — that is NOT the same as absent, and must not be reported as a negative finding.
pathology.warnFeatureBeyondSlide: {{count}} feature(s) ask for finer detail than this scan holds: {{features}}. The slide's finest resolution is {{finest}} µm/px, so they were answered at that limit rather than at what the question asked for. Reading closer is not possible on this slide — treat these answers as formed below the requested resolution, and say so; do not report them as a closer look being available.

sync.enableTitle: Synchronizovat tento výřez (Shift+klik: vybrat body ručně)
sync.enabledApproximate: Výřezy jsou propojeny, ale sklíčka nebylo možné přesně spárovat — zarovnání je přibližné. Pro ruční kalibraci použijte Shift+klik na SYNC.
sync.needsTwoSlides: Synchronizace je možná při otevření více než jednoho sklíčka.
sync.pickPoints: Pro kalibraci synchronizace klikněte na tři odpovídající body. Tažením posouváte, Backspace vrátí poslední bod, Esc zruší.
sync.resetTitle: Vymazat zarovnání tohoto výřezu — další LINK jej zarovná ručně
sync.cleared: Zarovnání vymazáno — pro výběr bodů použijte znovu LINK
sync.sessionCleared: Relace synchronizace vymazána — pro výběr bodů použijte znovu LINK
sync.autoSyncAllHint: Registrovat každé otevřené sklíčko vůči aktivnímu a propojit jejich výřezy
sync.autoSyncNone: Žádný výřez nebylo možné automaticky zarovnat
sync.recalibrateHint: Vyberte tři odpovídající body pro zarovnání aktivního výřezu
sync.resetAllHint: Odpojit všechny výřezy a zahodit všechna uložená zarovnání — další LINK zarovná ručně

oidc.clientSecretWarning: Kontext OIDC '{{contextId}}' nastavuje client_secret v klientovi prohlížeče — to není bezpečné (tajemství se odešle do prohlížeče). Pro důvěrné klienty použijte serverový modul oidc-server-ts.
oidc.storageNotPersisting: Přihlášení ke službě {{service}} se nepodařilo dokončit: prohlížeč nezachoval přihlašovací údaje během přesměrování. Obvykle to znamená, že úložiště webu je pro tuto stránku blokováno. Povolte pro tento web cookies a data webu, nebo otevřete prohlížeč mimo soukromý/vložený režim a zkuste to znovu.
oidc.completingSignIn: Dokončování přihlášení — toto okno se zavře automaticky.
oidc.retryInSeconds: Přihlášení ke službě {{service}} se nezdařilo, nový pokus za {{seconds}} s.
oidc.popupBlocked: Přihlášení ke službě {{service}} vyžaduje nové okno. Povolte prosím vyskakovací okna pro tento web.
oidc.loginCancelled: Pro použití služby {{service}} se musíte přihlásit.
oidc.loginFailedUnknown: Přihlášení ke službě {{service}} selhalo z neznámého důvodu. Zkuste to prosím znovu nebo problém nahlaste.
oidc.redirectUriMismatch: Přihlášení ke službě {{service}} bylo odmítnuto: poskytovatel identity nerozpoznal adresu přesměrování této aplikace. Správce musí jako autorizovanou adresu URI přesměrování zaregistrovat přesně tuto URL: {{uri}}
oidc.sessionExpiredReload: Vaše relace služby {{service}} vypršela. Pro nové přihlášení prosím načtěte stránku znovu.
